employer_campaign_health_pace_prefix: To meet the target you need about

employer_campaign_health_viewed_48h_hint: Of applications submitted over 48 hours ago

employer_campaign_health_backlog_help: Applications still marked Submitted and unopened after more than 48 hours. You'll get an alert at 5 or more.
employer_campaign_health_funnel_help: Applications that reached each stage, including those later rejected. Percentages are of all applications, so you can see where most drop off.
employer_campaign_health_funnel_descript: Applications that reached each stage, based on current applications.

employer_campaign_health_budget_descript: Costs are entered per channel in the Channels & sources tab.

employer_campaign_health_trend_descripti: Snapshot taken once a day; the dashed line is the target.

employer_campaign_health_formula_rates_d: (stages with fewer than 20 completed applications use the default rate)
employer_campaign_health_formula_hire_ra: Hire rate {rate}%, smoothed so campaigns with few applications aren't overestimated.
employer_campaign_health_formula_thresho: . At risk when the forecast is below target; off track when below 70% of target.

employer_campaign_jobs_empty: This campaign has no job postings yet

employer_campaign_perf_impressions_help: How often the campaign's jobs appeared in listings, search results or recommendations on ProCV.
employer_campaign_perf_views_help: How often candidates opened the job details page.
employer_campaign_perf_applications_help: Applications submitted to the jobs in the selected period.
employer_campaign_perf_view_rate_help: Job views ÷ impressions. Shows whether the title and salary are compelling enough to click.
employer_campaign_perf_application_rate_: Applications ÷ job views. Shows whether the job description convinces readers to apply.
employer_campaign_overview_unique_candid: Distinct people who applied. Someone who applied to two jobs in the campaign still counts as one.
employer_campaign_overview_applications_: Candidate–job pairs. Applying to two jobs counts as two applications; reapplying to the same job counts only the latest.
employer_campaign_overview_hired_help: Distinct people with an application marked Hired in the campaign.
employer_campaign_overview_performance_d: Impressions, views and applications over the selected period.

employer_campaign_overview_all_good_desc: No new CVs or expired jobs to handle.
employer_campaign_overview_distribution_: Latest status of each candidate–job pair — not a conversion rate.

employer_campaign_help_clicks: Distinct people who clicked the channel's tracking link. Each person counts once per day; automatic opens by Facebook or Zalo to build link previews aren't counted.
employer_campaign_help_applications: Applications credited to the channel: the candidate visited through the channel's link within 30 days before applying.

employer_campaign_help_hires: Applications from the channel that were moved to Hired.
employer_campaign_help_spent: Total costs you recorded in the channel's Costs section, such as ads or printed flyers. ProCV doesn't charge for any of these.
employer_campaign_help_cost_per_applicat: Spend ÷ applications. The average cost of getting one application from this channel; lower is better.
employer_campaign_help_cost_per_hire: Spend ÷ hires. The average cost of hiring one person through this channel.
employer_campaign_help_budget_share: Channel spend ÷ the campaign's maximum budget.
employer_campaign_costs_note: Record what you paid to promote through this channel, such as ads or printed flyers. ProCV doesn't charge anything; these figures are only used to calculate cost per application and compare channels.
